entries.title: Genesis 26:1
segments: And there was a famine in the land, besides the famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines to Gerar.

entries.title: Genesis 26:2
segments: And the LORD appeared to him and said, Do not go down into Egypt. Live in the land which I shall tell you of.

entries.title: Genesis 26:3
segments: Stay in this land, and I will be with you and bless you. For to you and to your seed I will give all these lands; and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

entries.title: Genesis 26:4
segments: And I will make your seed to multiply as the stars of the heavens, and will give to your seed all these lands. And in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed,

entries.title: Genesis 26:5
segments: because Abraham obeyed My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws.

entries.title: Genesis 26:6
segments: And Isaac lived in Gerar.

entries.title: Genesis 26:7
segments: And the men of the place asked about his wife. And he said, She is my sister. For he feared to say, My wife; lest the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah, because she was beautiful of form.

entries.title: Genesis 26:8
segments: And when he had been there a long time, it happened that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out through the window, and saw; and behold! Isaac [was] caressing Rebekah his wife.

entries.title: Genesis 26:9
segments: And Abimelech called Isaac and said, Behold! She surely [is] your wife. And why did you say, She [is] my sister? And Isaac said to him, Because I said, Lest I die on account of her.

entries.title: Genesis 26:10
segments: And Abimelech said, What [is] this you have done to us? One of the people might have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us.

entries.title: Genesis 26:11
segments: And Abimelech charged all his people, saying, He that touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Genesis 26:12
segments: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and received in the same year a hundredfold. And the LORD blessed him.

entries.title: Genesis 26:13
segments: And the man became great. And he went forward and grew until he grew very great.

entries.title: Genesis 26:14
segments: And he had possession of flocks and possession of herds, and many servants. And the Philistines envied him.

entries.title: Genesis 26:15
segments: For all the wells which his father's servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped them and filled them with earth.

entries.title: Genesis 26:16
segments: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go away from us, for you are mightier than we are.

entries.title: Genesis 26:17
segments: And Isaac departed from there, and pitched his tent in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

entries.title: Genesis 26:18
segments: And Isaac dug again the wells of water which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. And he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

entries.title: Genesis 26:19
segments: And Isaac's servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

entries.title: Genesis 26:20
segments: And the herdsmen of Gerar strove with Isaac's herdsmen, saying, The water is ours. And he called the name of the well Contention, because they strove with him.

entries.title: Genesis 26:21
segments: And they dug another well, and [they] strove for that also. And he called the name of it Opposition.

entries.title: Genesis 26:22
segments: And he moved from there, and dug another well, and they did not strive for that. And he called the name of it Broad Places. And he said, For now the LORD has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

entries.title: Genesis 26:23
segments: And he went from there to Beer-sheba.

entries.title: Genesis 26:24
segments: And the LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, I [am] the God of Abraham your father. Do not fear, for I [am] with you, and will bless you and multiply your seed for My servant Abraham's sake.

entries.title: Genesis 26:25
segments: And he built an altar there, and called upon the name of the LORD, and pitched his tent there. And Isaac's servants dug a well there.

entries.title: Genesis 26:26
segments: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath, one of his friends, and Phicol the commander of his army.

entries.title: Genesis 26:27
segments: And Isaac said to them, Why do you come to me, since you hate me and have sent me away from you?

entries.title: Genesis 26:28
segments: And they said, We saw certainly that the LORD was with you. And we said, Let there be now an oath between us, between us and you, and let us make a covenant with you;

entries.title: Genesis 26:29
segments: that you will do us no harm since we have not touched you, and since we have done nothing but good to you, and have sent you away in peace. You are now the blessed of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 26:30
segments: And he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

entries.title: Genesis 26:31
segments: And they rose up early in the morning, and swore to one another. And Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

entries.title: Genesis 26:32
segments: And the same day it happened, Isaac's servants came and told him about the well which they had dug. And they said to him, We have found water.

entries.title: Genesis 26:33
segments: And he called it Shebah. Therefore the name of the city [is] The Well of Sheba to this day.

entries.title: Genesis 26:34
segments: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite;

entries.title: Genesis 26:35
segments: who were a grief of spirit to Isaac and to Rebekah.
